items.title: Pierre Merlin Interview, 1961-08-14
items.q: I was, of course, influenced by the records I heard. Rex Stewart and Biggs Bayder Beck and Armstrong, of course.

ctx.x: it out, did you play like anyone else? Did you imitate anyone in the beginning?
Oh, I'm not sure. I was, of course, influenced by the records I heard. Rex Stewart and Biggs Bayder Beck and Armstrong, of course.
And then after you moved to Paris, did you change your style at all?
